news.comment: The Lions acquired Cisco from the Jets on Monday in exchange for a 2028 sixth-round pick, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
Palmer (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Monday, Joe Buscaglia of the Athletic reports.

The Jaguars acquired Godchaux from the Saints on Monday in exchange for a 2028 sixth-round pick, though the selection could turn into a 2027 sixth-round pick if "conditions are met," Jonathan Jones of The Athletic of The Athletic reports.
Minshew is slated undergo testing on his right elbow/arm in the wake of Sunday's loss to the Seahawks, according to Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site.
TeSlaa caught one of his two targets for 10 yards in the Lions' 20-17 win over the Packers on Sunday.
As Week 10 approaches, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com indicates that Brooks (ankle) could be ready to return from IR.
Coach Mike LaFleur revealed Monday that Wilson is out for the season due to a fracture in his neck, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.
Wilson notched six catches (on seven targets) for 60 yards during Sunday's 17-3 loss in Seattle.
When asked if IR is a possibility for Jacobs (finger), coach Matt LaFleur said Monday, "I think everything is a possibility," Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.
